title: AI-Driven Drowsiness Detection: Enhancing Road Safety through Inclusive and Real-Time Monitoring
summary: Catalink is validating a driver-monitoring prototype. Fewer crashes and safer public transport remain intended outcomes.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: Catalink is validating a driver-monitoring prototype. Fewer crashes and safer public transport remain intended outcomes. Research and prototype validation.
purpose: Detect driver fatigue across diverse users and driving conditions.

ratings.reason: Drivers and passengers are intended to be safer; no prevented crash or observed intervention is reported.
Transport operators are intended to monitor fatigue more reliably; no operational improvement is measured.

ai_role.statement: The chapter describes this system as supporting the stated purpose. Its causal contribution to the benefit has not been separately assessed.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
evidence.title: Use Case 2: AI-Driven Drowsiness Detection: Enhancing Road Safety through Inclusive and Real-Time Monitoring

produced_by: Causal conditions are not established separately in the extracted chapter.
must_hold: Specific replication requirements are not established in the extracted chapter.
